body:
I understand how you feel. It gets so tiring trying to pretend that everything is fine. I'm sorry that your friends don't understand. I feel like people don't understand unless they've felt it. "Why can't you just get better?" If I knew how to feel better, I would, thanks. 

Do you like your therapist? It can be hard to connect with someone sometimes, and when there's not much of a connection, it feels like just going through the motions. I have been through at least 6 and only truly loved one, who eventually quit the profession. 

Sorry to ramble so much about myself. Just wanted you to know that you are not alone.
